name: Vanilla Lava Cake Tarantula | 1g
description:
Rich vanilla and chocolate cake batter. This is our heaviest indica flavor. If you want to be unconscious by 10pm, this is the one. Dense, sweet, with a finish that lingers. The knockout punch of the lineup.

* Liquid Diamond Infused: Injected with concentrate for amplified potency.
* Kief Crusted: Rolled in kief for an extra layer of flavor and THC.
